title: 镜中倒影惊现诡异延迟与独立意识
prompt_en: 【Style】Vlog Style, Hyper-realism, Fixed camera realistic feel, Natural light, Hint of suspense and horror. 【Duration】15 seconds 【Protagonist (Remember to upload reference image)】A sexy young beautiful woman, preparing to wash up and sleep in front of the bathroom sink at home. [00:00-00:06] Shot 1: Normalcy. Scene: In front of a large mirror in an ordinary bathroom. Action: The protagonist is brushing her teeth facing the mirror, mouth full of foam. While brushing, she makes various funny faces at the mirror (winking and making faces). Key details: The reflection in the mirror is completely normal at this time, movements are synchronized. [00:06-00:11] Shot 2: The Glitch. Action: The protagonist finishes brushing, lowers head to spit out foam, then turns around preparing to leave the bathroom. High-energy moment (Core climax): Just when the protagonist's real body has turned and left the mirror frame range, the "reflection" in the mirror actually **did not move**! That "reflection" still maintains the brushing posture, even smirks and raises an eyebrow at the camera, staying for a full 2 seconds before suddenly "glitching" in panic to catch up with the main body's movement and disappear. Director's note: Create an extremely realistic "network lag" feel, a feeling that the reflection has independent consciousness. [00:11-00:15] Shot 3: The Punchline. Action: The protagonist, having reached the door, seems to sense something is wrong and suddenly looks back at the mirror. Result: The mirror is now completely normal, empty, reflecting only the opposite wall. The protagonist looks blank and terrified, scans the room, revealing a horrified expression. The frame freezes on the protagonist's confused face (horror movie effect).
